Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

The competition ignites with the Racing speed of rapid-fire volleys during an intense "equipment battle" between the power of the Selkirk Boomstick and the precision of Team Joola. Masterful Skills are on display as athletes execute flawless Around the Post (ATP) winners and tactical dink rallies that keep the pressure mounting. Amidst the Freestyle creativity of the collegiate circuit, witness morale-shifting momentum swings and desperate scrapping for every point as these top-tier programs fight for national dominance.

programme.title: Cesar Millan: Better Human Better Dog
programme.desc: Cesar sets out to help a young couple's sensitive Australian cattle dog, whose severe separation anxiety has held hostage the lives of his pet parents for nearly a year. And later, Cesar attempts to calm a blinding Lhasa Apso, who lacks basic hygiene and has almost become too hostile for his exhausted owners to provide his needed eye care.

While playing at World Aircraft, the Super Pets accidentally damage a new satellite dish. Jett delivers a robot puppy to a little girl named Lien in Singapore. But Lien wanted a real puppy, not a robot.

programme.title: Charm City Investigates: Haunted America
programme.desc: The TCC team investigates an old abandoned hospital in Benham, Kentucky. The hospital was built in 1922 and has now been shut down for many years. The building now belongs to the city. Over its years in operation, it was the central hospital for the area. It treated everything from common colds to gunshot wounds. After it closed, numerous stories were told about the location. One story was of a worker being scared so badly that he ran out of the building and refused to go back in. Thomas and Tony visit the hospital in an attempt to document some of the activity.

programme.title: VERSION FRANCAISE-S11
programme.desc: He is an iconic figure in French rap. Writer, composer and musician, Oli forms a cult duo with his brother Bigflo, now enjoying international popularity. It's less well known, but the rapper is also an art lover, and he's our guest to talk about it. And among the talents that Oli had chosen to exhibit in his Musée imaginaire, at the Abattoirs in Toulouse, there was a name on the rise: Karl N'da Adopo. Originally from the Ivory Coast, the artist conceives painted works inspired by major contemporary issues. And Alex Vizorek has his eye on the brilliant Paul Cézanne in Vizorek'xpert!

It's less well known, but the rapper is also an art lover, and he's our guest to talk about it. And among the talents that Oli had chosen to exhibit in his Musée imaginaire, at the Abattoirs in Toulouse, there was a name on the rise: Karl N'da Adopo. Originally from the Ivory Coast, the artist conceives painted works inspired by major contemporary issues. And Alex Vizorek has his eye on the brilliant Paul Cézanne in Vizorek'xpert!

programme.title: The Highest Honor
programme.desc: In the early days of the Cold War, the Soviet blockade of Berlin prompts a humanitarian airlift of monumental proportions. As the United States enters the Korean Conflict, Air Forcefliers battle for air superiority against the fastest, most maneuverable jets in the world: Soviet MIGS. Against this backdrop, American and Soviet scientists make enormous advances in missile technology, and international geopolitics becomes a game of stalemate.
